result:
**Verdict: PASS**, with no new findings. I reviewed DG6 round 10 on candidate `56415aee…c392d1b3` (source `cde60365`, 2766 files), and the recomputed candidate ID matched in a disposable clone. Both of my open findings verify CLOSED_VERIFIED:

- **F-DG6-560 (Medium): CLOSED_VERIFIED.**
  - **API:** round 8's reproduction now gives the intended result on the real API, along with 14 harder cases (18/18). Removing, reordering or moving restricted conditions keeps each hidden value with its own condition.
  - **UI, en and ar:** on the real demo stack the condition the author kept keeps its own value.
  - **Round-9 repair:** saving the same form twice without a reload now sends the current version's token, and nothing is swapped. A save after someone else's save gets 409, shows the "changed, re-apply" message in both languages and reloads the form; re-applying keeps the hidden value. A token from an older version is refused with 422.
  - **Mutants:** reverting each part of the fix makes tests fail: 22 failures for the original pairing bug, 8 for the missing version check, 2 for the missing editor reload.
- **F-DG6-561 (Low): CLOSED_VERIFIED.** All 27 uses of the "Includes restricted records" label now say whether they mark a total or an item. Rows and conditions show the item description in en and ar, and making the label always say "total" breaks 10 of the candidate's own tests.

**Full review results** (all in disposable clones):
- **Static checks:** all pass. The first lint and format runs failed only on my own probe files; a clean clone passes both.
- **Unit tests:** pass on Node 24.21.0 and Node 22.22.0, with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8. Node 22.22.2, which the assignment names, is not installed; I used the 22.22.0 present at `/opt/node22`.
- **Integration, run twice:** all 438 candidate files pass and 118 migrations apply to an empty database. The contract test passes and every pending-operation list is empty.
- **`tests/qa` alone:** 45 files, 437 tests pass.
- **End-to-end:** product journeys, the 22 root acceptance specs and the demo-stack specs pass in en and ar, in both locale settings, after the re-runs below. Axe reports no serious or critical issues on scanned screens.
- **My probes pass:** auditor read-only pass, layout at 360 px, 390 px and 200 % text, and cross-site-scripting (XSS) payloads shown as text.
- **Reliability:** the kill-and-restart drills pass, and the worker burst gives one execution per event.
- **Load (provisional, one shared sandbox host):** p95 was 38 ms for reads, 61 ms for updates and 78 ms for dashboards. All 66 exports finished, and only the requester could download each one.
- **Validator:** historical DG5 to DG1, register DG6 and pipeline all pass.

**Failures I saw, all re-run alone and passed:**
- Browser crashes, timeouts and Vitest connection timeouts while the kernel was killing processes for lack of memory, with three reviews sharing one machine.
- One "disk full" failure in an integration run.
- One duplicate organization code from the test harness's random-code helper (test-only, no product effect).
- Two errors in my own probes: I used a user without permission to edit rules as the second writer, and I left out the spec that sets up a precondition. Both were fixed and the probes then passed.

**Observations, not defects:**
- A token copied from another rule is accepted, but it only resolves to the target rule's own value, so nothing is revealed or swapped. The editor never sends one.
- If reloading the form after a 409 itself fails, the message still says the form is current. The next save would be refused, so nothing is misplaced.
- On the D-232 questions, connector configuration names (D-229) and the cross-organization ruling (D-228 (4)) hold: I found no disclosure, no lost or misplaced value, and no misleading screen.

**Assignment discrepancies:** it asks for `round: 7`, but the validator requires the round to match the folder, so I recorded 10. It says migrations end at 0125; the tree ends at 0126.

**Files written:**
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-10/qa-verifier.json`
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-10/qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-10/qa-verifier.md`
- Evidence in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/round-10/`
- My tests in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/tests/round-10/`

No findings sidecar was written. The clones and scratch data have been removed.
